name: BTC vs ETH: Rolling 30-Day Realized Volatility Comparison
description: Compares rolling 30-day annualized realized volatility (stddev of daily log returns × √365) between BTC and ETH. Includes per-asset vol over time, BTC/ETH vol ratio with 1.0 reference line, and a summary table with current, average, min, and max vol for both assets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH: Rolling 30-Day Realized Volatility Comparison
# =============================================================================
# Realized vol = annualized stddev of daily log returns over 30-day rolling window
# Crypto trades 24/7 → annualization factor = sqrt(365)
# =============================================================================

# --- Per-Asset Data (runs for each asset in universe: BTC, ETH) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Daily log returns
log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(close)

# Rolling 30-day standard deviation of log returns, annualized
rolling_stddev = stddev(period=30)(log_ret)
realized_vol = rolling_stddev * sqrt(365)

# --- Summary Stats (expanding window for table) ---
vol_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(realized_vol)
vol_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(realized_vol)
vol_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(realized_vol)

# --- Vol Ratio: BTC vol / ETH vol (reference data, asset-independent) ---
btc_ref = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.BTCUSD)()
eth_ref = common_crypto_pairs(ticker=ReferenceCryptoPair.ETHUSD)()

btc_log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(btc_ref.c)
eth_log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(eth_ref.c)

btc_vol = stddev(period=30)(btc_log_ret) * sqrt(365)
eth_vol = stddev(period=30)(eth_log_ret) * sqrt(365)

vol_ratio = btc_vol / eth_vol

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Rolling 30-Day Realized Vol — BTC vs ETH over time
cs_lines(
    title='BTC Vol Compressing Faster Than ETH Heading Into 2026',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Realized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=realized_vol)

# Chart 2: BTC/ETH Vol Ratio over time (agg=Mean collapses duplicate lines)
cs_lines(
    title='BTC/ETH Vol Ratio: Below 1.0 = BTC Relatively Calmer',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Vol Ratio (BTC / ETH)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=vol_ratio)

# Table: Current, average, min, max realized vol per asset
cs_summary_table(
    title='30-Day Realized Volatility Summary',
    category='Volatility Comparison',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=2,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current 30d Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Period Average', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Period Min', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Period Max', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(realized_vol, vol_avg, vol_min, vol_max)
